findings.title: No visible test file for runner package
findings.description: runner.go exists but no corresponding runner_test.go file found. Critical error paths are untested.
findings.suggestion: Create runner_test.go with mock HTTP server tests for all error paths.
findings.impact: High - error handling reliability is unknown.

findings.title: No testing of job state transitions
findings.description: The state machine (pending → running → completed/failed) is not tested. No verification that states transition correctly.
missingTests: postResult fails but final status still attempted
findings.suggestion: Mock http.Client and test each state transition with different response codes.
findings.impact: Jobs could end up in incorrect states without detection.

findings.title: poll() error handling not tested
findings.description: poll() logs but continues on fetchPendingJobs() error. No test verifies this behavior.
testCases: fetchPendingJobs() returns error → poll() logs and returns
fetchPendingJobs() returns empty list → no jobs processed
fetchPendingJobs() returns multiple jobs → all processed
findings.impact: Medium - error recovery path is unclear.

findings.title: Lack of mock for HTTP client in tests
findings.description: No mock http.Client visible. Testing would require real network calls or hacking with test hooks.
findings.suggestion: Pass http.Client interface (or create one) as dependency injection in Config for testability.
findings.benefit: Tests can run without network, reliably mock any HTTP scenario.
findings.impact: Medium - testability is reduced without proper mocking.
